senses.gloss: f. (עָכַן; cmp. חֲכִינָא) annulated snake. [Lam. R. to I, 3 אמר עכן בית, read, as Num. R. s. 12 אמרו אעפ״כ מת.]—
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16:1">Lev. R. s. 16</cite> (play on <he>תעכסנה</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 3:16">Is. III, 16</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00746"><he>עֶכֶס</he></cite>) <he>והיה אותו הריח … כארס של ע׳</he> and the scent (of the balsam) permeated them like the venom of a snake; <cite ref="Shabbat 62b">Sabb. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>כארס של ע׳</he> Ms. O. (ed. <he>כארס בכעוס</he>, v. <cite ref="K00963"><he>כָּעוּס</he></cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1031">Yalk. Lam. 1031</cite> <he>ונצרר עכנה בהם</he> (a misplaced corrupt. of <he>כארס של ע׳</he>).—Pl. <he>עֲכָנִים</he>, <he>עֲכָנִין</he>.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 321">Sifré Deut. 321</cite> (ref. to <he>זחלי עפר</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:24">Deut. XXXII, 24</cite>) <he>אלו ע׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>עשנים</he>, Var. <he>הכינים</he>, read: <he>חֲכִינִים</he>) that means the snakes whose rulership is in the dust; Yalk. ib. 945 <cite ref="P00736"><he>עֲכִינִין</he></cite>.
